class.name: NNBTSpatialActionLeaf
class.brief_description: Base class for 2D and 3D spatial behaviour tree actions.
class.description: Shared base class for [NNBTMoveTo2D], [NNBTMoveTo3D], [NNBTLookAt2D], and [NNBTLookAt3D]. Provides [member target_source] so the target can come from a fixed global position, a scene node, or a blackboard key, re-read each tick to follow moving targets.

members.member: Blackboard key holding the target node or position when [member target_source] is [constant TARGET_BLACKBOARD].
Target [Node2D] or [Node3D] when [member target_source] is [constant TARGET_NODE].
Where the target position comes from. See [enum TargetSource].

constants.constant: Uses the subclass's [code]target_position[/code] vector in global coordinates.
Uses the global position of [member target_node].
Uses the node or position stored under [member target_key] in the blackboard.
